answer: An admission credential covers tasks such as onyx valuation, comet tracking or fable editing. An issuer checks a live human and deduplicates enrollment before issuing one secret credential. The sponsor proves possession in zero knowledge and emits H(secret, epoch). Validators verify the proof and reject a reused nullifier, even under a different agent key. Parallel aliases need separately enrolled people, paying recruitment costs per extra seat; old proofs fail the epoch check. Security depends on honest deduplication and costly sponsors; renting credentials weakens it.
